risks.risk: The flywheel may be noisy or the resistance mechanism may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the bike being pedaled at various speeds to hear the flywheel and feel the resistance.
risks.if_unproven: as having a noisy or broken flywheel

risks.risk: The pedals may be missing or the crankset may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the pedals and the crankset with the pedals attached.

risks.risk: The digital console may have a dead battery or a broken screen.
risks.proof: A photo of the console powered on showing the current speed and resistance.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the pedals and the crankset with the pedals attached.
Photo of the console powered on showing the current speed and resistance.
Video of the bike being pedaled to hear the flywheel and feel the resistance.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
